subject: VM evidence: scan rhythm, rapid-patch proof & evidence portal delivery
messages:
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@starkbank.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: StarkBank Security Team <security@starkbank.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Request: scan cadence evidence + CVE closure proof

Laura —

Thanks for taking this. We're wrapping the SIG review for our Q4 audit and need a compact packet proving:

- regular VM scan cadence for production services (dates + tool used),
- SLA for critical CVE remediation (commitments + observed timelines),
- formal proof that CVE-2027-4455 affecting the inference runtime was remediated and validated (patch, test runs, and rollback plan).

Can you share the scan index and the remediation log for CVE-2027-4455? Ideally we want a single archive or portal link we can upload into our internal evidence tracker by COB Monday (13 Dec). If you have a short statement that binds the timeline to Redwood's SLA (45-day critical) that would speed the SIG signoff.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Adams
Lead Security Engineer, StarkBank
security@starkbank.com

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Short plan below and ETA for a single upload to your tracker.

What you'll get: a single archive link containing the quarterly scan index (tool timestamps and scopes), a remediation log for CVE-2027-4455 (patch commits, test run output, and canary results), and a signed SLA commitment PDF that maps our 45-day critical remediation SLA to the CVE timeline.

Preliminary timeline:
- Today (Dec 9): compile raw scan index and remediation artifacts.
- Fri Dec 10: internal QA + generate compact archive + pre-signed Drive link.
- Mon Dec 13 by 10:00 PST: formal upload to your evidence tracker and DocuSign letter (signed).

Internal notes: Kim/Jonas — can you confirm the remediation log includes the following fields for our archive: CVE id, affected component, patch PR id, commit hash, deploy window, canary verification run id, and rollback play reference? Also confirm the scan tooling metadata (Trivy 0.37 and our internal host-scanner v2.1) is included.

Laura Bennett

Also confirm the scan tooling metadata (Trivy 0.37 and our internal host-scanner v2.1) is included.

Confirmed. I'm attaching the compiled artifacts for internal review (will create public share after sign-off):

- redwood_scan_index_2027Q4.csv (scan dates, host lists, tool versions, scan severity counts)
- cve-2027-4455-remediation-log.pdf (PR + commits + deploy timestamps + verification logs)
- sla-commitment-letter-signed.pdf (executive-signed SLA statement for critical CVEs)

Notes on CVE-2027-4455:
- Affected: infer-runtime/kv-cache module (patch in PR #8240).
- Patch deployed to canary cluster: 2027-11-26T03:42:00Z.
- Canary verification: 6h smoke suite + tokenization regression check; no regressions observed.
- Full rollout: 2027-11-29T02:15:00Z (all regions).
- Root cause: integer overflow in kv eviction when sequence windows > 2^31. Patch adds bounds checks + unit tests.

I'll prep the Drive share and the secure portal upload once Laura OKs.

—Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Claire — attaching the compact packet and the portal link per your ask. Apologies for the weekend note; we wanted to make the upload window clear so your SIG can finish the review Monday.

What we uploaded:
- Single archive (Drive link below) with: redwood_scan_index_2027Q4.csv, cve-2027-4455-remediation-log.pdf, and sla-commitment-letter-signed.pdf. The remediation log contains PR ids, commit hashes, deploy timestamps, smoke test output, and the rollback play reference.

Evidence portal entry: https://redwood-secure-portal.example.com/evidence/queue/78f9a (view-only link has been provisioned to security@starkbank.com). Link also appended to your internal tracker.

Signed SLA excerpt (plain language): "Redwood Inference commits to a 45-day remediation SLA for critical (CVSS 9.0+) vulnerabilities in production-scope inference services. For CVE-2027-4455, the window from internal detection to full production rollout was 18 days; verification logs and deploy artifacts are included in the remediation log." (Please see sla-commitment-letter-signed.pdf for executive signature and scope language.)

If you need any additional artifacts (packet checksum, signed audit hash, or expanded test logs) speak up and we'll add them to the same portal entry. If this satisfies the SIG upload, let us know and we'll mark the item closed on our side.

Thanks —
Laura
